Cost: Mailchimp's plan comparison shows the Free plan with up to 250 contacts (one pricing page line also mentions fewer than 500). The pricing pages do not say whether API access is included on the Free plan, so we could not confirm it. Paid plans are Essentials, Standard and Premium. With the USD view, Essentials starts at $8.87 a month for the smallest contact tier (the page also shows a 50% off promotion for 12 months). Prices rise with contact count.

Good to know: the root endpoint returns a pricing_plan_type field (monthly, pay_as_you_go or forever_free), which you can use to check the account.

Does Mailchimp Marketing API have a free tier?
Free tier: Free plan (250 contacts); API access not confirmed.

Pricing model: Paid. Pricing starts from $8.87/mo. Essentials at the smallest contact tier, USD list price (a 50% promo for 12 months is shown). Rises with contacts.

snippet:
In the screenshot and bullet points below, you'll find the pricing across the subscriptions for 500 contacts; you can easily change that number on their [pricing page](https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/).
- **Premium**: $350/month, which includes 15,000 monthly email sends, unlimited users, unlimited audiences, and a lot more
- **Standard:** $20/month, which includes 6,000 monthly email sends, 5 user seats, and 5 audiences, and 1 personalized on-boarding session
- **Essentials:** Free for 1 month and then $13/month after. This plan includes 5,000 monthly email sends, 3 user seats, and 3 audiences, with limited reporting and analytics
- **Free:** $0/month, which includes the basics: 1,000 monthly email sends, 1 user seat, 1 audience, and limited reporting and analytics

title: About Mailchimp Pricing Plans | Mailchimp
snippet:
Mailchimp offers several monthly pricing plans to get your business up and running.

We offer 4 types of Marketing plans: Free, Essentials, Standard, and Premium.

When you choose a monthly plan, you’ll decide how many contacts you want to store in Mailchimp. The number of contacts you choose will place you in a pricing tier that determines your contact limit and sending limit. Your plan type plus your pricing tier determines the amount of your monthly bill.

### Free
Our Free Marketing plan is ideal for beginners who want to grow their audience and create emails while testing out some of Mailchimp's tools and features. It includes all the basics you need to start marketing.
The Free plan includes up to 250 contacts and 500 sends per month, with a daily send limit of 250.
Here are some features included in the Free plan.
- 1 audience
- 1 seat, with Owner permissions
- A limited selection of basic, featured, and themed [email templates](https://mailchimp.com/help/types-of-templates/)
- Basic reporting
You can also try out marketing tools like landing pages and forms.
If you exceed the 250 contact limit in your Free plan, a hold is placed on sending live emails or test emails until you upgrade to a paid plan or reduce your contact total. You'll still be able to work on your emails and templates and collect and import new contacts.

### Mailchimp Transactional
Mailchimp Transactional is a powerful delivery API tool. Use Mailchimp Transactional to send e-commerce notifications and automated transactional email and SMS messages such as password resets, order notifications, and appointment reminders. Mailchimp Transactional is designed for developers and requires HTML and API knowledge to design and send email and SMS messages. To learn more, check out our [Mailchimp Transactional Email Guides](https://mailchimp.com/developer/transactional/).
